items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Oh, number one musician Tio was.

ctx.x: Dad knows what he's doing with anything he picked up. He said baritone horn, but he was playing that with us in the neighborhood. He could play that baritone horn. He's a good musician. His dad was a good baritone horn player. Yeah. His dad was one of the best. He had to play for one-year-old horn. Yeah. He had to play for one-year-old horn. Yeah. He had to play for one-year-old horn. Yeah. I'm calling him everything. Sumter. Sumter. Sumter. Sumter. Sumter. I thought it was Sumter and La Bada. Sumter. Sumter. Tio…
You know Tio, huh? Oh, number one musician Tio was. They were beatin' vocals in there. He was one of the best I ever knew. Yeah, he was a sight reader.
They called you anything besides Sumter? Joe. Joe. I heard him call you Joe.
